title: Cosmic production catalogue supplement: final detailed-playtest corrections
scope: Adds one illustrated identity and records five added recipes plus one replaced recipe. The original 193-recipe catalogue and story-lock remain unchanged as the art-design baseline; this supplement is not a replacement full manuscript inventory.

new_items.name: Proto-Earth with hydrated material
new_items.physical_depiction: The same charcoal growing Earth with amber fissures and a modest right-hand cutaway containing angular grey-brown stony clasts with thin pale mineral veins.
new_items.avoidance: The clasts remain stony, with no shiny metallic droplets or finished metal core. No surface ocean, liquid water, blue pools, ice, atmosphere, molecular diagram, modern continents or second planet.

symbolic_role.meaning: A cutaway view of the continuing growing Earth; hydrogen-bearing material is represented as rocky accretion, not visible free water.

existing_art_corrections: Neutral hydrogen can release trapped light directly, using existing artwork.
Inherited icy dust can join cold outer-disk solids directly, using existing artwork.
The early sea can recharge seafloor fractures before its later surface states, using existing artwork.
Breaking waves erode the existing fractured basalt headland rather than the older cracked-crust identity; its existing icon remains selected.
new_branch: Hydrogen-bearing rock may accrete before the separately represented metal-rich fragments. hydrated-embryo then accepts metal-fragments to reach the same young-earth result as the pre-existing metal-first route.
recognition_limit: At 72px the added image distinguishes a rocky cutaway from the inherited-metal state; hydration and exact hydrogen-bearing chemistry depend on the normal name and reading. Art-review verdicts remain separate from this provenance supplement.
